head.purpose: Reconstruct candidate academic and applied Fields from fixed stakeholder-defined Business Strategy Domains through multiple independent observation perspectives.
principles: Business Strategy Domains are stakeholder-defined semantic boundaries and must be preserved without academic reinterpretation at this layer.
Each observer independently inspects the complete BSD structure before proposing Fields.
Observers may produce overlapping, conflicting, differently named, or differently scoped Fields.
Do not force consensus between observers during observation.
Prefer established Fields over narrow topics, techniques, occupations, or temporary technology labels.
A Field proposed by an observer should include traceable evidence whenever an authoritative or representative source is available.
A URL counts as evidence only when its content semantically supports the corresponding observation.
Field convergence, normalization, deduplication, and final validation occur after multi-observer observation.
LLM prior knowledge may propose candidates but must not be treated as evidence.
